# pi-glance 0.6.6

A maintainability and native-editor compatibility release for Pi 0.84.4.

## Fixes

- Preserve Pi's native Bash-mode border cue for `!` and `!!` input, including leading whitespace. The live frame reuses the public editor `borderColor`; normal prompts, titles, and status segments keep the selected Glance palette. No additional setting is required. Fixes [#6](https://github.com/LinYS77/pi-glance/issues/6).
- Keep Context warning/error colors in tokens-only display. Emphasis now follows Pi's unrounded public percentage in every display density instead of parsing formatted text; unknown percentages are not inferred from token counts.
- Avoid Pi 0.84's one-column wide-grapheme wrapping recursion in extremely narrow Glance frames while preserving editor text and width-safe output.

## Architecture and maintenance

- Separate pure configuration rules from path-bound file storage, preserving load diagnostics, read-only safeguards, schema migrations, and atomic saves.
- Separate Git snapshot construction and parsing from process execution and polling.
- Keep segment emphasis and feature-specific icon spacing with the display feature instead of the generic renderer.
- Make theme-browser state explicit and pass all preview inputs through the pane view model.
- Share curated setting-option cycling without adding a settings framework.
- Organize production code under `src/`, behavior tests by responsibility under `tests/`, and shared test adapters under `tests/support/`. The Pi package entry remains `index.ts`.
- Replace copied test interfaces and source-expression assertions with real project interfaces, named behavior tests, and independent visual fixtures.
- Add shared recursive import analysis, transitive no-IO rules, cycle checks, and an exact npm package file-tree test.
- Reuse one Node validation workflow for CI and GitHub Release, avoiding duplicate ordinary tag CI.
- Remove historical repository clutter. `CONTEXT.md` is the maintained source/design reference; local ADRs are no longer tracked. Published release notes remain available in GitHub Releases and historical tags.

## Compatibility

- Built and tested with Pi 0.84.4.
- Requires Node.js 22.19.0 or newer.
- Config schema remains v8; no migration is required.
- Preserves editor ownership, lifecycle accounting, Model speed measurement, and shared live/preview frame behavior.
- Uses only public Pi extension and TUI interfaces; adds no runtime dependencies.
- npm publication is performed manually by the project owner.

## Upgrade

After the npm release is available:

```bash
pi update npm:pi-glance
```

Then run `/reload` in Pi.
